High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Action Menu API.

Provides a UI for displaying a hierarchical menu of actions. Includes ARC-managed handles for ActionMenuLevel to prevent leaks if a menu is never opened.

Imports

../ffi, ../ffi/managed

Types

ActionMenuLevelHandle = object

Managed handle for ActionMenuLevel hierarchy.

Ownership: This handle owns the entire hierarchy starting from this level. If the menu is opened via openActionMenu, the OS takes ownership and this handle should be marked as consumed to avoid double-free.
